subject: general
question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. The
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins with S1, which describes the procession breaking up into groups at the square. This introduces the setting and the context. 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it introduces the eight men standing before the altar, setting the stage for the description of their duty: 
 
 
• "Before the altar, from which Pantaleone had been so recently dethroned, stood eight men, chosen to the rare privilege of raising the statue of St. Gonselvo." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence B comes next** as it describes the powerful group of eight men, elaborating on their appearance and demeanor: 
 
 
• "They presented a powerful group, as they stood there, ears pierced by dangling gold earrings and eyes bright with the gleam of religious fanaticism." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence D follows** as it adds details about their consciousness of their important duty and their agitation: 
 
 
• "Speechless they stood, conscious of their important duty, and somewhat agitated." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence A comes next** as it lists the names of the eight men, providing a conclusive detail about the group: 
 
 
• "They were: Giovanni Curo, ?Ummalido, Mattao, Vincenzo Guanno, Rocco di Ceuzo, Benedette Gallante, Biagio di Clisci, and Giovanni Senzapaura." 
 
 
 
• The paragraph concludes with S2, which describes how the men tested their strength and smiled faintly, adding a human touch to the scene. 
 
• The correct sequence is **CBDA**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The procession was coming from the church in a continuous stream, breaking up into groups at the square. Before the altar, from which Pantaleone had been so recently dethroned, stood eight men, chosen to the rare privilege of raising the statue of St. Gonselvo. They presented a powerful group, as they stood there, ears pierced by dangling gold earrings and eyes bright with the gleam of religious fanaticism. Speechless they stood, conscious of their important duty, and somewhat agitated. They were: Giovanni Curo, ?Ummalido, Mattao, Vincenzo Guanno, Rocco di Ceuzo, Benedette Gallante, Biagio di Clisci, and Giovanni Senzapaura. Now and then they would feel their biceps and pulse as if to try their strength, and sometimes a faint smile would flit over their faces."</div
